actionable_steps.citation: Educare Is Human Values — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-09-26
actionable_steps.step: Speak truth and practise righteousness every day — sathyam vada, dharmam chara.

actionable_steps.citation: Experience the Sweetness of Rama's Name — SSS Vol 39 (2006), 2006-04-07
actionable_steps.step: Keep your thoughts, words and deeds in perfect harmony — that is what makes you truly human.

actionable_steps.citation: Sathya and Dharma are Natural Attributes of Man — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-24
actionable_steps.step: Let your conscience be your master — act only on what your heart approves.
Foster dharma in daily life and let it sanctify your wealth and purify your desires.
Practise dharma yourself before you ever speak of it — practice is the only qualification to propagate it.

definition.citation: Love Propels Man Toward God — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-18
definition.quote: What is this Dharma? "Dharayathe ithi Dharmah" (Dharma is that which upholds everything). This means that without Dharma the Cosmos cannot exist. Dharma is the lifebreath of all actions.

discourses.citation: One God : basic truth of all faiths — SSS Vol 18 (1985), 1985-12-25
discourses.quote: The birth place of Dharma is the heart. What emanates from the heart as a pure idea, when translated into action will be called Dharma.

discourses.citation: Love Propels Man Toward God — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-06-18
discourses.quote: For man, the Dharma is Righteousness. Righteousness implies harmony in thought, word and deed. The unity of body, speech and mind promotes purity and sacredness in man. This triune purity constitutes humanness.

discourses.citation: Experience the Sweetness of Rama's Name — SSS Vol 39 (2006), 2006-04-07
discourses.quote: Dharayati iti dharma (that which sustains is dharma)... Dharma should flow from one's own heart. Then, it should be put into practice. Do as you say. That is man's foremost duty.

discourses.citation: Develop Love for God and Experience Happiness in Prakriti — SSS Vol 39 (2006), 2006-08-12
discourses.quote: What is dharma? Dharma truly is the very foundation of the mansion of life. You may build a multi-storied building, but without the foundation, it will not last long.

make_it_real: Dharma is not a rulebook — it is the pure idea rising in your heart, lived out loud.
title: Dharma / Righteousness

vahinis.quote: Dharma is the moral path; the moral path is the light; the light is bliss (ananda). Dharma is characterized by holiness, peace, truth, and fortitude. Dharma is yoga, union, merger; it is truth (sathya).

Dharma protects those who protect it (Dharmo rakshati rakshitah), says the scripture. If people come forward to foster the sources of dharma, that good act, by itself, will help foster those who do it.
